title: Ask Categorization as Cognitive Scaffold
short description: Retains ask categorization as a planner reasoning discipline while routing all asks through shell-agent.

title: Go as Implementation Language
short description: Chooses Go for Machtiani's concurrent process orchestration text processing and single-binary distribution.

title: Keep Gmail out of the default mail-transport catalog
short description: Excludes Gmail from DearMachine's default transport catalog reserving it for use only as a user pairing address.

title: Umbrella Project Pattern
short description: Adopts a git-submodule umbrella repository to preserve a shared network and audience while keeping per-project version histories.

title: No Explicit Abort: Stop-and-Resume Preemption Subsumes Abort
short description: Same-thread follow-ups gracefully stop and resume work without abort-specific machinery.

title: Use Versioned Documentation Paths for Agent Reference
short description: Uses one path-based versioned documentation tree for humans and agents without documentation-specific commands tools or synchronized runtime copies.

title: Canonical Managed Launchers Without Shell Edits
short description: Keeps managed commands in ~/.local/bin and retires superseded installations explicitly without editing shell startup files.
